description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Persistent Specimen, adding {B}.
When Persistent Specimen dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and goading it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Persistent Specimen by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
